headline: Recyclable Wildflower installation among timber prototypes at BuildFest 2026
context: A recyclable timber pavilion designed to mimic wildflowers is among the prototypes built by students at BuildFest 2026, shown in this video produced by Dezeen. Designed by students from Lehigh University and Syracuse University, Wildflowers uses custom-designed 3D-printed joints

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: A recyclable timber pavilion designed to mimic wildflowers is among the prototypes built by students at BuildFest 2026, shown in this video produced by Dezeen. Designed by students from Lehigh University and Syracuse University, Wildflowers uses custom-designed 3D-printed joints to connect timber columns in an X shape that resembles flowers.
